headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers (text-5xl to text-7xl). Emphasize elegance, tension, and a premium warm Indian furniture aesthetic. Do not use Inter or Roboto.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for contrast against the ornate serif.

accents.usage: Uppercase, wide letter spacing (tracking-widest), tiny (text-xs or text-sm) for overlines, labels, and small UI details.

visual_enhancers.borders: Delicate 1px borders (#DCD6CD) for structure. Avoid heavy, thick lines.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient, large diffuse shadows for product cards on hover: shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(26,24,23,0.06)].
visual_enhancers.corners: Minimal rounding (rounded-none or rounded-sm) to retain an architectural, premium furniture feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-20) in hero backgrounds or heavy dark sections to kill digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.general_spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24. Containers must breathe, avoiding cramped elements.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Asymmetric layout or 60/40 split. Large serif typography overlapping with high-res product photography. Masked line-by-line text reveal on load.
grids_and_layouts.manifesto_section: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03). Use massive serif numerals. Wide left margins to create editorial tension.
grids_and_layouts.product_catalogue: Grid layout: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Images must have consistent aspect ratio (e.g. aspect-[4/5]) with zoom on hover. Do not use standard Shadcn cards; use cardless raw images with text underneath.
grids_and_layouts.product_details: Two-column sticky layout on desktop. Left side: smooth-scroll image gallery. Right side: Sticky product info, price, and the 'Order via WhatsApp' action block.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout (w-64) on desktop. High density, technical look. Table views for inventory with clear status badges.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Lenis smooth scrolling for premium browser feel.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion. Elements slide up slightly (y: 30, opacity: 0 to 1) with custom easing [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1].
motion.hero_load: Kinetic text reveal. Masked line-by-line using overflow-hidden and y-axis translation.
motion.hover_states: Images scale up slightly (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden wrappers. Button backgrounds slide or fade smoothly.
motion.marquee: One very slow editorial marquee (e.g., 'CRAFTED FOR HOME — PREMIUM MATERIALS — MAHADEVI FURNITURES'). Font-serif, large outline text.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp corners (rounded-none). Primary CTA is solid Accent (#8C5A35). WhatsApp button should use WhatsApp Green (#25D366) only on the PDP action context.
components.navigation: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF7F2]/80). Must NOT be fully transparent. Border bottom 1px.
components.product_card: Cardless design. Raw image with text underneath. Left-aligned title, serif price.
components.admin_tables: Shadcn UI tables. Minimalist, dense. Actions via dropdown menus.
components.toast: Use Sonner for notifications (e.g., 'Product updated successfully'). Position bottom-right.

whatsapp_integration.flow: User clicks 'Order Now'. A Shadcn Dialog opens prompting for Name, Address, and Quantity. On submit, constructs URL: 'Hello, I want to order [Quantity]x [Product Name]. My name is [Name], Address: [Address].' and redirects to wa.me.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No purple, no standard generic tailwind gradients.
Use standard React .jsx or .js files as this project does not use .tsx (TypeScript). Adjust imports and syntax accordingly.
Use Playfair Display for headings and Outfit for body. Ensure they are loaded via Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
Use Framer Motion for line-by-line hero text reveals and scrolling animations.
Implement the 'Order via WhatsApp' flow using a customized Shadcn Dialog to capture user details before generating the wa.me link.
Admin Dashboard must be protected by simple JWT Auth. Admin UI should be practical, using Shadcn tables and forms.
Product images must maintain a strict aspect ratio in grids (e.g., aspect-[4/5]) to avoid broken layouts.
Ensure the Header has a backdrop-blur background, NEVER fully transparent if content scrolls beneath it.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-order-btn').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text colors meet APCA/WCAG standards on their backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must be visible. Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand_accent/50.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like admin table actions).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use large typography, stark contrasts, and asymmetric grids where appropriate.
Create depth through layered design elements with precise z-index management.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`). Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Do not center-align paragraphs; left-align dense content.
Never use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided image_urls.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, press states).
